description: Search the Rijksmuseum's ~800,000-object collection — Dutch Golden Age paintings, prints, drawings, photographs, Delftware, Asian art — by title, maker, object type, material, technique or object number, and get back real records: title, maker, date, materials, curatorial description, rights and a IIIF image URL. AUTHORITATIVE for what the Dutch national museum holds and how it catalogues it. Keyless. There is no free-text `q`: filters are field-scoped, and titles are catalogued in Dutch. Example: rijks_search({ creator: "Rembrandt", type: "painting", limit: 5 }).

creator.description: Maker name, e.g. "Rembrandt van Rijn" or "Vermeer".

imageAvailable.description: Only objects that have a published image.

limit.description: How many hits to hydrate into full records, 1-25. Default 10. Each costs one upstream fetch.

page_token.description: next_page_token from a previous call, to continue through the result set.

title.description: Words in the object title, as catalogued (Dutch), e.g. "Nachtwacht".

name: rijks_search
title: Rijks Search
